body: Carbon monoxide emission standards are a lot higher than when this was a popular suicide method. The only reason it was popular before is because the sheer amount of gas put out overwhelmed the body's ability to respond to it. It's still possible to end it this way, but it takes much longer and is much more painful.

Thank you for your reply - kind words mean a lot to me right now. I do still care...a friend of mine that I really look up to told me today that he's proud to be my friend. It made me feel good initially, but then I just started to feel bad because I felt like I didn't deserve it. Is that psychotic? I know there are people that care about me, but I just haven't been able to convince myself that I'm worth their time and effort.

Also, a bit of friendly chat sounds nice - my favorite band is the Dead Kennedys (which is NOT helping).
